product_metadata.title: Lucid 3 Inch Ventilated Bamboo Charcoal Memory Foam Mattress Topper - Twin XL Mattress Topper
features: MEMORY FOAM – 2 inches of soft responsive memory foam is an easy addition to help make a firm mattress soft. Foam mattress topper is ventilated to promote air transfer for a comfortable sleep climate.
BAMBOO CHARCOAL – Bamboo charcoal is infused in the bed topper, wicking away moisture and regulating odors for a fresh sleep environment
PROTECT YOUR TOPPER- We recommend using a Lucid mattress protector for your bed to protect against any leaks or spills to ensure a long life of the memory foam mattress topper
CERTIFIED FOAM – All Lucid memory foam is CertiPur-US certified for safety and performance of the mattress topper to give you peace of mind
TOPPER IN A BOX – We design all our Lucid mattress toppers to ship from our home to yours in an easy-to-carry box. Simply unbox, unroll, and wait 24-48 hours for the topper to expand.
description: At Lucid, we make beds for the whole family— because when you wake up feeling your best, your family gets the best version of you too. The Lucid 2-inch Bamboo Charcoal Memory Foam Mattress Topper is an affordable way to make a firm mattress plush. The two inches of responsive memory foam cradle your body. Designed to fit, a Twin XL size mattress topper perfectly complements a TwinXL mattress. And the bamboo charcoal infusion provides temperature regulation, and moisture wicking and odor reducing properties to maintain a fresh sleep environment. The foam topper is ventilated to promote air transfer, ensuring a comfortable sleep climate and all Lucid memory foam is CertiPur-US® Certified for safety and performance. For shipping convenience, the topper is shipped directly to your door in an easy-to-carry box. Comfort awaits.
